title: Audited lint policy: detectors retained, enforcement disabled
summary: This change splits lint detection from lint enforcement. A new compiled policy module (lints/policy.rs) marks twelve writing rules and five skill rules as off by default, and every consumer — the stop hook, `osf lint writing`, `osf lint skill`, and `osf verify` — now merges those off-levels into the config levels before applying overrides, so a repository's own config cannot re-enable an audited detector in a gate. Raw detector evaluation is untouched: fixtures still exercise disabled rules, and `osf explain` now prints an enforcement-status line. Alongside that, the script-pin check is rewritten from three regexes into a token-based command registry (lints/script_pins.rs) covering pip/npm/pnpm/cargo/docker/podman, each run emitting a mandatory coverage statement; the composite `skill-reads-as-manual` rule and the `parenthetical` writing rule are removed; em-dash narrows to U+2014 only; weasel-attribution accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link in the same sentence; reference-without-link is dropped in commit context; generated merge subjects are exempted from bare-reference; and the co-author trailer scan becomes case-insensitive.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: main.rs subcommands
nodes.summary: Dispatches lint writing, lint skill, verify and explain. Now prints a policy coverage line to stderr for lint runs and an enforcement-status line from explain.

nodes.label: Stop hook
nodes.subtitle: hook.rs checked_findings
nodes.summary: Runs on every turn end on the fast tier. It now merges the compiled off-levels over the config levels before applying overrides, so an audited detector cannot be re-enabled by a repository config in a stop check.

nodes.label: Writing lint
nodes.subtitle: lints/writing
nodes.summary: Evaluates raw writing detectors and applies context. Commit context now drops reference-without-link, exempts a generated merge subject from bare-reference, and weasel-attribution accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link in the same sentence.

nodes.label: Skill lint
nodes.subtitle: lints/skill
nodes.summary: Skill body checks. The composite skill-reads-as-manual rule is removed while its three component detectors remain, and script scanning delegates to the new token-based pin check.

nodes.label: Script pin check
nodes.subtitle: lints/script_pins.rs
nodes.summary: New literal command-token check replacing three regexes. A shared command registry covers pip, pip3, npm, pnpm, cargo, docker and podman, and the same registry supplies the mandatory coverage statement printed on each run.

nodes.label: Enforcement policy
nodes.subtitle: lints/policy.rs
nodes.summary: Compiled off-levels for twelve writing and five skill rules, plus helpers to merge writing and skill levels and to render the coverage statement. This is the single source of what is disabled from enforcement.

nodes.label: Scan rules
nodes.subtitle: scan/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Commit-message scanning. The co-author trailer check now matches the field name case-insensitively rather than requiring the exact spelling.

nodes.label: Config loader
nodes.subtitle: config.rs
nodes.summary: Loads osf.toml and compiled defaults. Writing and skill defaults now start from the compiled off-levels, and the gate path still reads must_explain_names for parity while undefined-name stays off.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: repository config
nodes.summary: The repository's own config. Its comment now records that must_explain_names is read under --gate for parity but does not add gate errors because undefined-name is off in the compiled policy.

nodes.label: Verify report
nodes.subtitle: verify.rs Report
nodes.summary: Carries a policy section alongside check outcomes and renders it in summaries and non-human formats. Pre-commit and pre-push now apply level overrides to writing and skill findings before reporting.

nodes.label: Audit tests
nodes.subtitle: audited_rule_policy, audited_detector_fixes
nodes.summary: Two new integration suites: one asserts disabled rules are not enforced while raw fixtures still evaluate them, the other pins the precise detector fixes such as trailer case, merge-subject exemption and install-token classification.

edges.label: lint skill

edges.label: skill_levels

flows.title: Stop hook: lint, merge policy, decide
flows.summary: What happens on every turn end after this change: the transcript is linted, the compiled off-levels are merged over the config levels, and only unsuppressed findings that survive can block.

views.title: Lint enforcement architecture
views.summary: Entry points call the lint engine, which now consults a compiled policy module before any finding is allowed to block. Configuration seeds its defaults from that same policy.

views.title: Verify pipeline and policy reporting
